items.title: Phone remote control behaviour
items.smarttube: Listens when link enabled; handles open video (with position and playlist), subtitles, update playlist, seek, play, pause, next, previous, get state, volume (absolute and delta) with feedback, stop, connected/disconnected (optional app close), D-pad keys, voice start/stop; posts play state, start-playing, volume and subtitle changes; remembers last video
ps5_evidence: native/tube_phone.c: cases TUBE_REMOTE_PLAYLIST, QUEUE, NEXT/PREVIOUS, PLAY/PAUSE, SEEK, STOP, VOLUME (has_volume or delta), DPAD, VOICE, CAPTIONS, DISCONNECTED, QUERY/CONNECTED/DEVICES
native/tube_remote.c / tube_remote.h: typed commands, update reporting
native/tube_provider.c: settings:remote:history 'History for phone playback'; tests/test_remote_history.c
gaps: Play / pause / seek / next / previous received with no active player are acknowledged without reopening the current or last remote video (SmartTube calls openNewVideo(getVideo() or getLastVideo())); no saved 'last video'
No 'device disconnected' message shown before closing the app
10-second start delay after app init not mirrored (harmless)
items.notes: Real-phone acceptance is still open per docs/REMOTE_SERVICE.md.

items.title: SponsorBlock playback behaviour
items.smarttube: Fetches segments for enabled categories (not for live); colour markers; 1 s poll; match window 2 s x speed; groups adjacent skip segments within 3 s; actions skip / toast / confirm dialog that auto-closes at segment end; ignore short; don't skip again; channel exclusion; player button: click skips the segment under the playhead or toggles SponsorBlock, long press opens settings
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: sponsor_response(), tube_skip_target_at_rate() (2.0*rate window, +3.0 grouping, minimum, no_repeat), tube_sponsor_prompt()/tube_sponsor_confirm(), tube_sponsor_markers(), sponsor_scope() (exclusions, not live)
scripts/player_actions_overlay.py: TUBE_PLAYER_SPONSOR row of the in-player options (channel exclusion); tests/test_player_menu.c
gaps: The in-player SponsorBlock row only toggles the channel exclusion: no manual skip of the segment the playhead is inside (full-match skip), no on/off toggle and no shortcut to SponsorBlock settings from the player
No on/off state indicator in the player controls
items.notes: PS5 adds R3 jump-to-highlight, which SmartTube handles as a normal category.

items.title: Live chat in player
items.smarttube: Opens live chat automatically when enabled and the video has a chat key; spam-author blacklist; button toggles; long press: Disabled / Left / Right
ps5_evidence: scripts/player_chat_overlay.py: labels 'Hide live chat', 'Live chat: left', 'Live chat: right'
companion/innertube/live_chat.mjs: blockedAuthors (same list); worker.test.mjs 'chat author filtering matches the pinned SmartTube Unicode spam patterns'
items.notes: PS5 also has a chat reader, replay and message sending. The separate left/right placement for the comments panel has no PS5 counterpart because comments are a browser screen.

items.title: Comments dialog
items.smarttube: Chat button on a non-live video opens comments beside the shrunken video; load more; click opens replies; long press toggles like; position/content restored when reopened for the same video; 'comments disabled' message
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: "discussion:" levels, "discussion:replies:<key>", tube_comment_text(), tube_comment_rating(), "comment:menu:" / "comment:confirm:" (like, dislike, remove)

native/tube_provider.c: comment_count and can_post on the first page, the viewer's own rating and creator state on rows, 'Write a comment' / 'Reply to comment' (comment:post, comment:reply, comment:review; comment_post / comment_reply once per confirmation); companion/innertube/comment_posts.mjs
gaps: Comments open only from the browser (R3 on a video), not from inside the player with the video still visible
No restore of the previous comment list position when reopening for the same video
Like is a reviewed menu action rather than an instant toggle with an optimistic count update
items.notes: Posting goes beyond the SmartTube surface listed here; rows are marked experimental. Reply confirmation shape inferred, not verified live.
